details.description: gpt-daybreak-blue-latest (Daybreak Blue) is an alias in OpenAI's Daybreak program for its flagship general-purpose model with safeguards calibrated for defensive cybersecurity work. It currently resolves to GPT-5.6 Sol, the flagship model in OpenAI's GPT-5.6 family, and takes text and image input with reasoning support. Its knowledge cutoff is February 16, 2026. Use requires separate approval and provisioning through the Daybreak program.
advantages: OpenAI describes it as an alias for its flagship general-purpose model with safeguards calibrated for defensive cybersecurity work (OpenAI gpt-daybreak-blue-latest model page).

Currently resolves to GPT-5.6 Sol, OpenAI's flagship GPT-5.6-family model with configurable reasoning effort (none through max), function calling, structured outputs, code interpreter, computer use and MCP (OpenAI gpt-daybreak-blue-latest and gpt-5.6-sol model pages).
As a defensive-safeguarded flagship alias, it is intended to be usable for both general-purpose reasoning and security-operations tasks (OpenAI gpt-daybreak-blue-latest model page).
disadvantages: Requires separate OpenAI approval and provisioning through the Daybreak program before it can be used (OpenAI gpt-daybreak-blue-latest model page).
Does not support audio or video input, or fine-tuning (OpenAI gpt-daybreak-blue-latest model page).
use_cases: Defensive cybersecurity work under added safeguards
General-purpose reasoning and complex professional work for organizations approved for the Daybreak program

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens is 922,000, but OpenAI's own gpt-daybreak-blue-latest model page currently lists a 1,050,000-token context window; kept the catalog's value and did not restate a number in the description, per instructions. Catalog's max_output_tokens (128,000), modality and /v1/responses-only endpoint otherwise match the page. As a '-latest' alias, which underlying snapshot it points to (GPT-5.6 Sol as of this research) can change over time. No benchmark table was published on the pages opened.
